integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytic score/curvature expansion with explicit exceptional-event and moment-control arguments; a deterministic Bernoulli calculation is included only as a finite cross-check. Literature comparisons distinguish conjectural or algorithmically different half-log regret results from the claim proved here.
scientific_limitations: Requires a nondegenerate bounded distribution and an oracle maximizer in the interior of the truncated betting interval. Fixed prior mass only; boundary-oracle, growing-prior-mass, pathwise-regret, and constant-order remainder claims are not made.
title: Universal half-log oracle regret for empirical and fixed-mass MDP bounded-mean betting
